park-bench.label: Park Bench
park-bench.pivot: ground origin at the seat centre
park-bench.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
park-bench.notes: Timber slatted bench with dark iron ends, 0.9 m long. The footprint covers the seat; the feet overhang it by 0.05 m at ground level.

signpost.label: Signpost
signpost.pivot: ground origin at the post's iron shoe
signpost.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
signpost.notes: A 1.3 m timber post with a cream board pointing right and a violet board pointing left. The footprint is the iron shoe; the boards overhang it at height.

stone-well.label: Stone Well
stone-well.pivot: ground origin at the ring centre
stone-well.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
stone-well.notes: A limestone ring 0.9 m across with a timber frame, violet hood and bucket, 1.45 m tall. The footprint is the ring; the hood eave stays within it.

cart-wheel.label: Cart Wheel
cart-wheel.pivot: ground contact at the bottom of the rim
cart-wheel.behavior: visual_only; unplaced candidate; no gameplay or collision changes
cart-wheel.notes: An upright iron-rimmed wagon wheel, 1.0 m across and 0.1 m thick, with six timber spokes. The footprint is a strip the wheel's width; the hub caps overhang it by 0.05 m.
